set: A new reference set for a new device: the Android parity emulator e07-android-parity, 402 x 874 dp at density 3.0 like the iPhone 16 Pro (owner default d), with Android's 44 dp status bar (the system image's punch-hole cutout sets it) and gesture navigation. It is not a change to the iOS set in assets/reference, which stays byte for byte.

referenceChanges.what: Every Android render and layout re-rendered with the measured safe top of 44 dp instead of 24 dp: everything below the status bar sits 20 dp lower, the status-bar mask is 44 dp tall. Nothing else in the design moved; the iOS set in assets/reference is unchanged.
referenceChanges.why: The first Android capture (E18-T20) measured the parity emulator's insets as the device profile asks: the pinned google_apis API 35 image draws a punch-hole cutout, so its status bar is 44 dp (132 px); every S2 element sat exactly 20 pt low against the 24 dp profile. A measured inset is a profile change by the skill's own rule (lead, 2026-10-16).

referenceChanges.what: Merge Siege added to the design as a design game. No frame or variant changed: the design and frames inputs of this manifest were re-recorded by a one-frame --update-reference (s4-home light-en, a byte-identical render).
referenceChanges.why: spec 13: its design pass, drafted on 2026-10-19 with the proposed defaults; the owner approves it with the E22-T01 message (pending), and the drafted design applies meanwhile
